name: Use owned Heal Minor Wounds on actual Canosel fight injury

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local t=0
local last=nil
local healed=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original healing course')
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local skill=types.NPC.stats.skills.restoration(self)
 print('VilverinContinue healing sample health='..health..' magicka='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current..' restoration='..skill.base..' progress='..skill.progress)
 if last and health>last+.01 then healed=true end;last=health
 if healed then print('VilverinContinue healing occurred') end
end}}}}
